use default
use Raster.IMAGE

use Point = (x: double, y: double)

let rise = System.Math.sqrt(3.0D) / 2.0D

koch(depth: int, from: Point, to: Point) -> Pipe[Point] is
    if depth == 0 then
        yield from
        return
    fi

    let dx = (to.x - from.x) / 3.0D
    let dy = (to.y - from.y) / 3.0D

    let third = (x = from.x + dx, y = from.y + dy)
    let twice = (x = from.x + 2.0D * dx, y = from.y + 2.0D * dy)

    let peak =
        (x = third.x + dx * 0.5D - dy * rise,
         y = third.y + dy * 0.5D + dx * rise)

    yield in koch(depth - 1, from, third)
    yield in koch(depth - 1, third, peak)
    yield in koch(depth - 1, peak, twice)
    yield in koch(depth - 1, twice, to)
si

let start = (x = 0.0D, y = 0.0D)
let finish = (x = 1.0D, y = 0.0D)

let points = koch(5, start, finish) |> collect_list()

points.add(finish)

let image = IMAGE(660, 220)

image.view(-0.1D, -0.06D, 1.1D, 0.34D)
image.colour(30ub, 60ub, 170ub)
image.stroke(1.4D)

image.line(points)

image.write("koch.png")

image.show("koch.png")
